components.name: base_freight
components.description: Base freight per km of booked lane distance, rate by billed weight band

components.name: express_premium
components.description: Express service, where booked, premium of 15% of base freight

components.name: fuel_surcharge
components.description: Fuel surcharge of 12% of the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable)

gaps.description: billed weights over 500 kg and under 501 kg fall in neither weight band (bands are 'up to and including 500 kg' and '501 kg to 2,000 kg'); base freight is not rated
consignments above 2,000 kg are quoted case by case and are outside the rate card; base freight is not rated
any service outside the schedule is priced only by the Customer's advance written agreement evidenced by a rate confirmation referencing the agreement; such rates are not in this contract

non_pricing.reason: states no other accessorial charges are payable; reflected by the spec listing no other components (any other billed charge code, e.g. detention, is uncontracted)
